subject: Learning Methods
title: The Compound Effect of SRS
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Compound Effect of SRS.

hook.text: After one year of adding 10 cards daily, he knew 3,600 facts cold, maintained in just 20 minutes a day.

buildup.text: SRS compounds: older cards need less frequent review, freeing slots for new material constantly.

discovery.text: In year two, daily review time barely increases even as total knowledge doubles. Mature cards are nearly free.

twist.text: Most people quit in the first month. Those who persist past 90 days usually continue for years.

climax.text: The payoff is exponential but delayed. Push through the slow start. The curve bends in your favor.

punchline.text: Day one feels slow. Month twelve feels like a superpower.

quiz.question: Why does daily review time barely increase in the second year of SRS?
options: Mature cards need very infrequent review, freeing slots
The algorithm deletes old cards automatically
